subject: Air freight quote to YYZ
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to YYZ (Toronto, CA), including the truck you arrange from our site in 45111 (Essen), Germany, to the departure airport?

The sports equipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-24. It is 10 pieces with a gross weight of 1390 kg and a volume of 4.41 cbm.

Please send me your all-in price in EUR and let me know the earliest possible arrival at YYZ.

Best greetings from Regensburg
Tobias Auer
Versand / Shipping
Auer Maschinenbau GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new all-in air freight quote for a specified shipment to YYZ.
